title: Spiced Potato and Broccoli Burgers with a Walnut Crust
changes_from_base: Meat-free and bun-free: mashed red potatoes with blanched broccoli, toasted cumin, nigella, garam masala and ricotta, rolled in ground walnuts, chilled and pan-fried; served with yoghurt or chutney.
summary: Substantial mashed potato and broccoli studded with toasted walnuts and warming spices creates hearty vegetarian patties with Indian character.
equipment: large heavy non-stick frying pan (30 cm)
wire rack over a baking tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
cumin seeds, toasted and lightly crushed
plain yoghurt, raita or chutney, to serve

steps.title: Broccoli
steps.text: Bring a pan of well-salted water to the boil, put 185 g finely chopped broccoli florets in a sieve and dip into the water for 1 min, rinse under cold water, shake and drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Steam 680 g quartered red potatoes over 2-3 cm of boiling water for about 15 min until tender and mash roughly with a fork in a large bowl (skins and all).

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir in 10 g chopped coriander, 2 tsp toasted and lightly crushed cumin seeds, 2 tsp lemon juice, 1 tsp nigella seeds, 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp ground black pepper, the drained broccoli and 60 g ricotta; season well and taste.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Spread 85 g walnuts pulsed to coarse crumbs in a wide bowl; scoop about 80 g of the mix at a time, roll into a ball, roll in walnuts and flatten gently into a patty (wet hands help), and chill on a plate for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Set a wire rack over a baking tray, heat 2 tbsp of 60 ml grapeseed or rapeseed oil in a large heavy non-stick frying pan over high, swirl, turn down to medium and fry 4-5 patties (do not crowd) for about 4 min a side until well browned; move to the rack.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the rest of the oil and cook the remaining patties, moving to the rack to keep warm in a low oven.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with 240 g plain yoghurt, raita or chutney and a salad.

tips: Pulse walnuts to coarse crumbs not fine powder for visible texture.
Chill patties for at least 1 hour so they firm up and hold together.
Serve with cooling yoghurt or raita to balance the warming spices.
storage: Store cooked patties in the fridge for up to 3 days; rewarm gently in a low oven for about 10 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
